world.name: Anzania
world.definition: An original fictional portfolio world created for Bongo Seakhoa.
world.disclaimer: Anzania is fictional. It is not Tanzania or any other real location.

locations.name: Threshold Dunes
locations.title: Work that turns ambiguity into usable systems.
locations.lead: I turn complex information into reliable data systems, practical analysis and decisions people can act on.

evidence.label: Current focus
evidence.value: Data engineering and analytics at MetaPOS

evidence.label: Working range
evidence.value: Data systems, decision support and applied machine learning

evidence.label: Based in
evidence.value: Debrecen, Hungary

locations.portalCaption: The horizon folds into the first evidence

locations.name: Stone Pass of Names
locations.title: One person, two surnames, one continuous body of work.
locations.lead: Bongo Seakhoa is the default professional name. Bongo Kosa is the alternate and legal name used in some records. The distinction is continuity, not a second persona.

evidence.label: Primary public name
evidence.value: Bongo Seakhoa

evidence.label: Alternate name
evidence.value: Bongo Kosa

evidence.label: Professional principle
evidence.value: Clarity over performance, evidence over ornament

locations.portalCaption: The inscriptions resolve into a factual record

locations.name: Garden of Origins
locations.title: Scientific roots, systems thinking and continued formal study.
locations.lead: A foundation in science grew into data, engineering and decision systems. The path remains deliberately interdisciplinary and grounded in continuous learning.

evidence.label: Current study
evidence.value: BSc in Engineering Management, University of Debrecen

evidence.label: Technical foundation
evidence.value: Data science, analytics and cloud engineering

evidence.label: Learning practice
evidence.value: Formal study, public experiments and verified credentials

locations.portalCaption: Hard desert light softens into water and shade

locations.name: Archive of Echoes
locations.title: Every claim should resolve into a project, role or verifiable artefact.
locations.lead: The archive is where reputation is tested. Public projects and client-safe summaries state scope, evidence and status directly rather than inflating experiments into outcomes.

evidence.label: Selected systems
evidence.value: Retail data, portfolio management and recommender workflows

evidence.label: Evidence standard
evidence.value: Public repositories or clearly labelled client-safe summaries

evidence.label: Research posture
evidence.value: Experiments are distinguished from publications

locations.portalCaption: Scrolls, instruments and evidence move into reach

locations.name: Forge of Resolve
locations.title: Reliability is designed through constraints, tests and ownership.
locations.lead: Useful technical work is not only a clever model or query. It is the discipline of making data flows dependable, explainable and maintainable under real operating pressure.

evidence.label: Engineering emphasis
evidence.value: Data quality, transformation logic and operational reporting

evidence.label: Delivery practice
evidence.value: Validation, documentation and clear recovery paths

evidence.label: Tooling
evidence.value: Python, SQL, cloud platforms, Docker and Git

locations.portalCaption: The system reveals how it is built to endure

locations.name: Bazaar of Skill
locations.title: Choose the problem first. Then choose the tools that earn their place.
locations.lead: The bazaar connects technical capability to useful engagements: reliable data foundations, analysis for decisions, applied models and clear technical communication.

evidence.label: Data engineering
evidence.value: Structured flows, modelling and quality foundations

evidence.label: Analytics
evidence.value: Findings, reporting and transparent recommendations

evidence.label: Applied ML
evidence.value: Framing, evaluation and lightweight delivery

locations.portalCaption: The avenue resolves into practical service paths

locations.name: Observatory of Horizons
locations.title: Research and analytics help examine possible directions, not pretend uncertainty is gone.
locations.lead: The observatory holds public technical experiments, current questions and long-range interests. Evidence, interpretation and ambition remain visibly distinct.

evidence.label: Inquiry
evidence.value: Trading systems, machine learning and environmental data

evidence.label: Method
evidence.value: Simulation, historical evaluation and explicit validation

evidence.label: Horizon
evidence.value: Systems thinking that connects technical and operating context

locations.portalCaption: The horizon rises into a field of tested questions

locations.name: Oasis of Audience
locations.title: Bring a data problem, a research question or a system that needs clarity.
locations.lead: The final location is not an ending. It is a direct path to collaboration, documents and the conventional portfolio for visitors who want every detail without the journey.

evidence.label: Availability
evidence.value: Remote, contract and globally distributed opportunities

evidence.label: Best starting point
evidence.value: A clear problem, current constraints and the decision at stake

evidence.label: Direct record
evidence.value: Resume, CV, project summaries and public contact paths

locations.portalCaption: The route settles into a clear next step
